title: Pesto Pasta Delight
description: A simple yet flavorful Italian dish made with fresh pesto sauce and perfectly cooked pasta.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.
Cook the pasta according to package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, combine pesto and parmesan cheese. Heat over medium heat, stirring occasionally.
Once the pasta is done, drain and add it to the skillet with pesto sauce.
Toss the pasta to coat with the pesto sauce.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped fresh basil and diced pears (if using).
